event_chain.summary: Hot wallets drained / source code taken
Funds burned to vanity addresses, exchange offline

summary: On June 18, 2025 pro-Israel hacking group Gonjeshke Darande (Predatory Sparrow) hacked Nobitex, Iran's largest cryptocurrency exchange, draining more than $90 million from its hot wallets into vanity addresses bearing anti-IRGC messages, effectively burning the funds. The group said it would publish Nobitex's source code and claimed the attack was retaliation for the exchange's role in sanctions evasion and terror financing; it had claimed an attack on Bank Sepah the day before. Nobitex's website went offline.
